RoboTwin 2.0 is a scalable framework for bimanual manipu- lation, integrating an expert data generation pipeline with a 50-task benchmark built on the RoboTwin Object Dataset (731 objects, 147 categories). A multimodal language agent automates task program synthesis, while flexible dual-arm configurations enable large-scale, diverse data collection.
